title: 8-bit LFSR
constraints: Feedback polynomial x⁸ + x⁶ + x⁵ + x⁴ + 1: the new bit is `q[7] ^ q[5] ^ q[4] ^ q[3]`.
Priority on a rising edge: `rst` (q = 8'h01), then `load` (q = seed), then `en` (shift).
hints: It is just an 8-bit register with a one-line next-state expression.
Compute the feedback bit from the *current* value of `q`.
With this polynomial and a non-zero seed the sequence repeats every 255 steps.

examples.title: load
examples.input: load = 1, seed = 0xA5 for one edge, then en = 1
